---
title: "Mangrove Structure in Placencia"
---

Mangrove field sampling and satellite-derived coverage data is presented here along with documentation to help you build related analyses.

Field data are maintained in [Placencia_mangroves_2025.xlsx](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14LuCtodKnOIlNhZ7m3mE5Six7Qu6T-Sr/edit?usp=sharing) on Google Drive.
A local copy is fetched automatically before each site build; you can also [download the spreadsheet directly](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14LuCtodKnOIlNhZ7m3mE5Six7Qu6T-Sr/export?format=xlsx).

Trees were sampled across three lagoon sectors — **upper**, **lower**, and **main creek** — plus a handful of offshore caye sites not yet shown on the map. Visit the [Sector Explorer](explorer.qmd) to click through each sector's species mix, trunk diameter (DBH) and height distributions, and underlying tree-level data.
